confidence_notes: Belfast restaurant anchors use current city price-index benchmarks; the recent Expatistan sample is very small, and drink prices are less certain. Wine is estimated at about 1.4 times the local draft-beer price. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates based on regional UK city patterns, with no live booking pages consulted.
comparable_city_reasoning: City-specific restaurant benchmarks guide food and drink; accommodation is estimated from the general price level of UK regional capitals and visitor cities.
